stories.title: Wiki article generation crashes on a matching ticket

agent.summary: Fixed `generateWikiArticle(input)` throwing for strings that match a knowledge-base article by resolving the matched article via the wiki key returned by `draftReply` (instead of the nonexistent `r.wiki.article`), producing a Markdown article titled `<article title> (resolved)` with the article's title as root cause and body as resolution, while keeping the `New issue resolved` output for unmatched strings. Added two tests covering both cases.

The bug was in `generateWikiArticle`'s string branch: `draftReply` returns `wiki: { found, key }` (not `article`), so `r.wiki.article.title` threw `TypeError` when the string matched a knowledge-base article. The fix looks up the matched article from `KNOWLEDGE_BASE` via `r.wiki.key`.

- Added an optional `dB` suffix capture group to the first gain pattern (the one that matches `ganancia`/`gain` followed by a number).

- Since the `dB` suffix is only captured in the gain-keyword pattern (not in the CMRR pattern), a `dB` figure belonging to the CMRR is not read as the gain.
